write_up: Your resume makes a strong case for Welder / Fitter work! At Maumee Steel Fabricators, you name the structures, welding processes, fit-up tolerance, and inspection results. Your earlier pipe work and certifications round out the story.

The Riverfront Tower line is the model: it names the job, the third-party inspections, and about 900 welds. A recruiter can see what was inspected without guessing. Your experience and certifications are also easy to find.

Add the work you handled during plant shutdowns, then consider moving the Riverfront Tower result to the top of the Maumee role. Your resume gives a recruiter plenty to work with; the competition for a particular job will matter too.
